This file provides metadata about the structure and content of this website to help large language models (LLMs) understand and navigate it effectively.

### Notable Projects
1. **airflow-extended-api-plugin** (78 stars)
   - Airflow plugin using CLI command as RESTful API
   - Supports Airflow v2.X
   - Language: Python

2. **cnpip** (43 stars)
   - CLI tool for switching pip mirrors in China
   - Automatically tests and selects fastest mirror
   - Language: Python

3. **Truer.ai / caoergou.github.io** (5 stars)
   - Navigation website collecting real AI applications
   - Built with Hugo and GitHub Actions
   - URL: https://truer.ai

4. **COVID-19Simulation** (12 stars)
   - COVID-19 spread simulation using turtle
   - Python programming practice project
   - Language: Python

5. **JS_answer** (7 stars)
   - Q&A community platform
   - Flask backend + LayUI frontend
   - Language: Python

6. **airlineReservationSystem** (2 stars)
   - RESTful airline reservation system
   - Spring Boot + Vue.js
   - Distributed systems course project
   - Language: Java

## Content Structure

### Pages

1. **Home Page** (`/`)
   - Hero section with personal introduction
   - Projects showcase (6 major projects)
   - Latest blog posts preview
   - Social media links (GitHub, Truer.ai)

2. **Blog** (`/blog`)
   - Blog posts list with excerpts
   - Topics: Python, Web Development, Distributed Systems, AI
   - Markdown-based content with syntax highlighting

3. **Blog Post** (`/blog/[slug]`)
   - Full content of individual blog posts
   - Markdown (MDX) format with YAML frontmatter
   - Metadata: title, date, description

### Content Types

1. **Blog Posts**
   - Format: Markdown (MDX) with YAML frontmatter
   - Categories: Python Development, Web Development, Distributed Systems, AI Applications, Three.js/3D Graphics
   - Metadata Fields: title, date, description, layout

2. **Projects**
   - Displayed on home page with descriptions
   - Fields: title, description, link, stars, language
   - All projects link to GitHub repositories

3. **Social Links**
   - GitHub: https://github.com/caoergou
   - Truer.ai: https://truer.ai

## Technology Stack

- **Static Site Generator**: Astro 4.x
- **Frontend Framework**: React 19
- **3D Graphics**: Three.js (animated background with geometric shapes and particles)
- **Markdown Processing**: @astrojs/mdx
- **Syntax Highlighting**: Shiki with Nord theme
- **Styling**: Custom CSS with gradient backgrounds
- **Deployment**: GitHub Pages / Vercel

## Visual Design

### 3D Background
- Animated geometric shapes (torus, icosahedron, octahedron)
- Floating particle system (1000 particles)
- Dynamic lighting with point lights
- Color scheme: Purple (#667eea), Pink (#764ba2), Teal (#20c997)

### Color Palette
- Primary: #667eea (Purple)
- Secondary: #764ba2 (Pink)
- Accent: #20c997 (Teal)
- Background: #0a0a0a (Dark)
- Text: White/Gray on dark, Dark on light cards

- Headings: Bold, 700 weight
- Body: Regular, 400 weight
